Pure Fiction

Pure Fiction contains a series of challenging stages. In this mode, you need to challenge the stages and earn the required number of points to pass the challenge and get splendid rewards. In addition, you will get bonus rewards for achieving specific targets. The difficulty and rewards of Pure Fiction stages are not affected by your Equilibrium Level. Stages and rewards in Pure Fiction are regular…

Gameplay Overview

In the Pure Fiction challenge, non-Boss enemy units will continuously respawn after being defeated. Each time a non-Boss unit is defeated, the Boss unit's HP will be reduced. Defeating the Boss unit allows you to clear that wave. With each update of Pure Fiction, a unique "Grit Mechanics" system is introduced. When triggered, it allows for rapid accumulation of Grit Value. Once fully charged, play…

Grit Value

Methods to accumulate Grit Value includes: ● Defeat enemy units to earn a small amount of Grit Value. ● Trigger the Grit Mechanics in battle to earn a large amount of Grit Value.

Grit Effects

Cacophony

Cacophony updates with various combat after each Pure Fiction update. You can select one of the buffs for each team before challenging any stage in the Pure Fiction.

Points

In this mode, enemies will appear for a limited number of Cycles. Defeating enemies or dealing DMG to the Boss enemy earns you points. Each stage contains two battles, namely Node 1 and Node 2. Your final points are the total points earned in both battles, and your highest points will be updated at the end of each battle.

Quick Unlock

All stages in Pure Fiction that have been cleared with a 3-star rating are recorded. When a new event starts, all the cleared stages and their prerequisite stages will be immediately unlocked. After Quick Unlock takes effect, You can directly challenge the last recorded stage that you passed with 3-stars.
